children: Six-month program to put OCAL's approval-first car-buying story in front of Canadian consumers
Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - August 29, 2026) - OCAL Financial Inc.
OCAL
" or the "
Company

") announces that it has signed a six-month social media marketing agreement with DIBO Marketing, launching a video-first campaign to bring OCAL's approval-first way of buying and financing a vehicle to a much wider Canadian audience. The Company also announces that it has engaged Signal Capital Advisors Inc. for investor relations and capital markets advisory services, as described below.

OCAL has built something most Canadians have not seen yet: a way to get approved for financing first, then have the right vehicle sourced and delivered to your door, all without setting foot on a car lot. The Company believes the biggest thing standing between that model and the customers it serves best is simple awareness. This campaign is built to close that gap, with short-form video at its core, told through the people who actually run OCAL and the customers for whom it delivers.

Under the program, DIBO Marketing will lead strategy, creative direction, production and publishing across OCAL's social channels. Each month includes a structured filming session, twenty video scripts, professional editing of the resulting short-form video, and a steady stream of posts covering how OCAL works, Company milestones and customer deliveries, along with monthly performance reporting and optimization. DIBO Marketing founder Denis Cicak will personally direct the first filming day in Vancouver to set the creative standard for the campaign.

The choice of format is deliberate. Car buying research has moved to the phone, and short-form video is where a huge share of it now happens: real walkarounds, real deliveries, real explanations of how financing works. That plays directly to OCAL's strengths. A company that operates remotely and delivers to the customer's door has a story that shows well on camera, and OCAL intends to tell it with its own team and real deliveries rather than stock footage and slogans.

The push comes at a deliberate moment. OCAL is growing its funded-deal volume in British Columbia and Alberta and preparing to enter Ontario, and a stronger consumer brand supports both. It also complements the demand-generation technology OCAL has been investing in: the campaign builds the audience, and OCAL's AI-driven lead capture, qualification and approval process turns that attention into funded deals. Content produced under the campaign will follow OCAL's approval and compliance review before publication, consistent with how the Company approaches all public communications.

"We are genuinely excited about this one," said Mehdi Moghareh, Chief Executive Officer of OCAL. "We have spent years building a better way to buy and finance a vehicle, and the people who find us love it. Now it is time for a lot more Canadians to see it. Video is where car buyers spend their time, and DIBO knows how to tell a story there. Denis and his team are going to help us show, not just tell, what approval-first car buying looks like."

"Every funded deal starts with someone hearing about us for the first time," added Mr. Moghareh. "This campaign is about making that first moment happen far more often, and doing it with content we are proud of. And as our consumer brand grows, Signal Capital will help us tell the OCAL story just as well to the investment community."
Engagement of Investor Relations Advisor
The Company entered into a consulting agreement (the "
Consulting Agreement
") with Signal Capital Advisors Inc. ("
Signal Capital

"). Under the Consulting Agreement, Signal Capital will provide investor relations and capital markets advisory services to the Company on a month-to-month basis. Either party may terminate the Consulting Agreement on 15 days' prior written notice. The services will include, without restriction: advising on investor relations, capital markets strategy and stakeholder communications; assisting in the preparation and refinement of investor presentations, corporate messaging and related marketing materials; representing the Company in meetings and engagements involving investors; supporting investor outreach, shareholder engagement and capital markets initiatives on a best-efforts basis; and providing periodic progress updates, strategic recommendations and market feedback to the management of the Company.

As consideration for the services, the Company will pay Signal Capital a cash fee of C$7,000, plus applicable taxes, per month. In addition to the cash fee, the Company shall grant a total of 100,000 stock options ("
IR Options
") to purchase common shares ("
Shares

") of the Company. The IR Options, which shall vest in 25% increments on the 3-month, 6-month, 9-month and 12-month anniversaries of the grant date, are exercisable over four years at an exercise price of $0.13.

Signal Capital is an Ontario corporation that provides investor relations and capital markets advisory services and has its head office at 40 Scollard St., Toronto, Ontario M5R 3S1. Signal Capital is owned and controlled by Shushu Feng, its founder and managing director, who will be the individual principally responsible for providing the services to the Company. Signal Capital and Ms. Feng are arm's length to the Company.
The Consulting Agreement and the engagement of Signal Capital remain subject to the acceptance of the TSX Venture Exchange.
About OCAL

OCAL Financial Inc. is an asset-light, AI-native virtual automotive dealership and vehicle-finance platform. Operating remotely and licensed in British Columbia and Alberta, OCAL moves customers from application to approval, vehicle matching, digital contracting and delivery in a single workflow. Rather than carrying owned inventory, OCAL sources each vehicle only after a customer is approved, drawing on the OPENLANE auction network and select partners. OCAL earns revenue from vehicle sales and related finance and protection products, and does not hold consumer loans or assume credit-default risk. Its technology stack, which includes workflow orchestration, a lender-routing credit-intelligence system, voice AI, and a centralized business-intelligence system, is built specifically for automotive transactions.
